achievements.title: First Spark
achievements.backText: Every expert was once a beginner. You placed your first component and started your journey.

achievements.title: Getting the Hang
achievements.backText: Five builds in. The breadboard is starting to feel like home.

achievements.title: Bench Regular
achievements.backText: Ten builds down. You show up, you build, you learn.

achievements.title: Prolific Builder
achievements.backText: Twenty-five circuits brought to life. That is real momentum.

achievements.title: Master Maker
achievements.backText: Fifty builds. You have wired more circuits than most hobbyists do in a year.

achievements.title: Centurion
achievements.backText: One hundred builds. The soldering iron fears you now.

achievements.title: Workshop Legend
achievements.backText: Two hundred and fifty builds. You are the person friends call when their project won't work.

achievements.title: Hall of Famer
achievements.backText: Five hundred builds. This is a body of work.

achievements.title: Consistent Builder
achievements.backText: Three days in a row. Consistency beats intensity every time.

achievements.title: Week Warrior
achievements.backText: A full week of daily building. Your muscle memory is forming.

achievements.title: Fortnight Fire
achievements.backText: Two weeks unbroken. This is officially a habit.

achievements.title: Monthly Maker
achievements.backText: A month straight. Most people quit by day three. Not you.

achievements.title: Unstoppable
achievements.backText: Sixty days. The streak owns part of your daily routine now.

achievements.title: Century Streak
achievements.backText: One hundred days without missing. Extraordinary discipline.

achievements.title: Year of Volts
achievements.backText: A full year, every single day. You are in rare company.

achievements.title: Warmed Up
achievements.backText: Five hundred XP. The fundamentals are settling in.

achievements.title: Charged Up
achievements.backText: A thousand XP. You are building real understanding, point by point.

achievements.title: High Voltage
achievements.backText: Twenty-five hundred XP. The concepts are clicking.

achievements.title: Power User
achievements.backText: Five thousand XP. You are well past dabbling.

achievements.title: Ohm Hero
achievements.backText: Ten thousand XP. Serious dedication, measured in volts and patience.

achievements.title: Resistance is Futile
achievements.backText: Twenty-five thousand XP. Few learners ever reach this.

achievements.title: Grid Master
achievements.backText: Fifty thousand XP. You have built an education one point at a time.

achievements.title: Unit Cleared
achievements.backText: A whole unit, start to finish. You see how the pieces connect.

achievements.title: Quarter Master
achievements.backText: Three units complete. The curriculum is opening up.

achievements.title: Halfway Home
achievements.backText: Six units down, the second half awaits. Momentum is on your side.

achievements.title: Scholar
achievements.backText: Every concept in the path, mastered. You have done the whole journey.

achievements.title: Clean Circuit
achievements.desc: Finish a build with zero wiring corrections
achievements.backText: Not a single wrong wire. Your spatial awareness is exceptional.

achievements.title: Steady Hands
achievements.backText: Five builds, no corrections. Precision is becoming second nature.

achievements.title: Flawless
achievements.backText: Twenty-five perfect builds. You measure twice and wire once.

achievements.title: First Sketch
achievements.backText: Your first schematic checked out. Drawing is thinking on paper.

achievements.title: Draughtsman
achievements.backText: Ten clean schematics. You can show your thinking, not just build it.

achievements.title: Schematic Savant
achievements.backText: Fifty schematics graded correct. You read and draw circuits fluently.

achievements.title: Tutor, Engaged
achievements.desc: Run your first live tutor session
achievements.backText: You went hands-on with the live tutor watching your bench. This is the magic.

achievements.title: Bench Buddy
achievements.backText: Ten sessions with the tutor. It is starting to feel like a real lab partner.

achievements.title: Live Wire
achievements.backText: Fifty live sessions. The bench tutor knows your style by now.

achievements.title: Digital Twin
achievements.backText: Your build, immortalised in 3D. A trophy you can spin.

achievements.title: Twin Collector
achievements.backText: Five 3D twins in your gallery. A growing portfolio of real work.

achievements.title: Mirror Maker
achievements.backText: Twenty-five digital twins. A museum of everything you have built.

achievements.title: Crowd Pleaser
achievements.backText: Ten likes across your posts. People are watching what you build.

achievements.title: Community Star
achievements.backText: Your builds inspire others. The community has spoken.

achievements.title: Local Hero
achievements.backText: Two hundred and fifty likes. You are a name people recognise.

achievements.title: Show & Tell
achievements.backText: You put your work out there. That takes courage and it builds community.

achievements.title: Storyteller
achievements.backText: Ten builds shared. Your feed is a journal of real progress.

achievements.title: Prolific Poster
achievements.backText: Fifty posts. You give the community something to learn from.

achievements.title: Helping Hand
achievements.backText: Five helpful replies. Builders helping builders, exactly the point.

achievements.title: Mentor
achievements.backText: Fifty comments of guidance. You lift the people coming up behind you.

achievements.title: Challenger
achievements.backText: You signed up for the arena. Shared goals make the work stick.

achievements.title: Challenge Seeker
achievements.backText: Five challenges in. You thrive on a target and a deadline.

achievements.title: Podium Finish
achievements.desc: Finish top 3 in a weekly league
achievements.backText: Tested against the field, you placed on the podium when it counted.

achievements.title: League Champion
achievements.backText: Five podium weeks. Consistency at the top is the hardest kind.
